fix(justfile): pull build and twine into publish recipe ephemerally

nbdev-pypi shells out to `python -m build` and `twine upload`, so the
ephemeral env needs both available. Without them the recipe fails
mid-publish with "twine not found" after the build step succeeds.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(justfile): use nbdev's new dash-style scripts and --with nbdev

nbdev renamed its console scripts from nbdev_pypi/nbdev_export style
to nbdev-pypi/nbdev-export style, breaking every nbdev-using recipe.
Also `uv run` syncs the venv from pyproject deps each invocation, so
the manually-installed nbdev from `just install-dev` gets evicted
before the recipe runs. Pull nbdev in ephemerally with `uv run --with
nbdev` so the recipes work standalone.

notebook source so nbdev-export keeps producing the fixed output.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: chunk zoom recordings list into 30-day windows

Zoom's /users/me/recordings endpoint silently caps any from/to range to
30 days, so list_recordings(days) returned at most ~30 days of meetings
regardless of the --days flag. Walk the requested range newest→oldest in
≤30-day windows, paginating each window with next_page_token and deduping
by meeting id.

Code review fixes: sync settings.ini, fix schema inconsistency, add input validation

- Sync settings.ini with pyproject.toml (version, deps, entry points) to prevent
  nbdev from reverting changes on export
- Fix output field name: _format_liked_tweet now uses "public_metrics" consistently
- Add _validate_username() to prevent path traversal in snapshot filenames
- Deduplicate fetch_liked_tweets/fetch_bookmarks_list into _fetch_tweets_paginated()
- Merge identical _api_headers/_user_auth_headers into single _auth_headers()
- Fix rate-limit retry loop: only retries on 429, simplified dead retry counter
- Add safety limit (50k) to fetch_following pagination
- Clean up: import re (not re_mod), remove redundant AGENTS.md
- Add tests for missing X_ACCESS_TOKEN error path and public_metrics assertion
- Regenerate uv.lock
